devotionals.title: The Measure of the Gift
devotionals.reflection: God did not love the world from a distance; He gave Himself into it. The cross is not a compromise of justice but its fullest satisfaction, offered freely to everyone who believes. Let today be a day you receive — and then want to give — that same love without reserve.

devotionals.title: Hands Empty, Hands Full
devotionals.reflection: Salvation is a gift, and a gift can only be received with open, empty hands. Whatever is in your hand this morning — achievement, regret, striving — lay it down. Grace did not begin with your effort and it will not end without it.

devotionals.title: One Level Ground
devotionals.reflection: Every mouth is stopped; the whole world is guilty before God. Yet this verdict is not the floor of despair but the door of grace, for it clears the way for the righteousness that comes by faith. We are all beggars — and all of us are welcome.

devotionals.title: Wages or a Gift
devotionals.reflection: What you have earned has already been paid — and its wages are not worth describing. What God gives is not wages at all, but a gift that opens into eternal life. Stop negotiating with heaven for fair payment; take the better deal in Christ.

devotionals.title: The Old Has Passed Away
devotionals.reflection: Union with Christ does not renovate the old self; it ends it, and begins a new creation. The past that defines and haunts you is not your identity. Behold, all things have become new — walk today as someone who has started over in Him.

devotionals.title: Not by Works, but by Faith
devotionals.reflection: The Reformation was not a new idea but the recovery of this ancient one: no one is justified by works of the law, but by faith in Christ. Your standing before God rests on what He has done, not on what you are doing. Breathe that in.

devotionals.title: He Who Began It
devotionals.reflection: Perseverance does not mean you hold tightly to God; it means God holds tightly to you. The work begun by grace is completed by the same grace, on the same day. You are not keeping yourself saved; you are being kept. Rest in the grip.

devotionals.title: I Shall Not Want
devotionals.reflection: The Lord is my Shepherd — everything else in the psalm is what follows from that. Not 'I have everything,' but 'I shall not want,' because the Shepherd is enough. Your wants become witnesses: they can be trusted because He is good.

devotionals.title: The Subject Matter of Faith
devotionals.reflection: Faith is not wishful feeling but the assurance of things hoped for, the conviction of things not seen. It stands on the promises of a God who cannot lie and a resurrection already settled in history. When feelings fail, faith remains.

devotionals.title: Joy in the Firebox
devotionals.reflection: Consider it pure joy when you meet trials — not because pain is good, but because the testing of faith is producing something intended: steadfastness, maturity, completeness. The refiner keeps His eye on the gold, and on you.

devotionals.title: The Renewed Mind
devotionals.reflection: Do not be conformed to this world; be transformed by the renewal of your mind. Christianity is not an emotional notch on the week but a re-training of the whole thinking world. Let the Word reset the grid of how you see everything today.

devotionals.title: Go
devotionals.reflection: The Great Commission is the marching order of a risen King who holds all authority. It begins with 'Go,' not 'Stay,' and it is not a program in the church but the shape of the church. Somewhere today, a neighbor is a nation in miniature.

devotionals.title: According to the Scriptures
devotionals.reflection: Christ died for our sins — not as a footnote of history but according to the Scriptures, the very hinge of all God's promises. The gospel is pre-announced, fulfilled, and verified by witnesses. Nothing rests on your interpretation of your feelings.

devotionals.title: Alpha and Omega
devotionals.reflection: The beginning of your story and its ending are the same Person. Every 'Alpha' you have passed — first steps, first faith, first prayers — He was there; every 'Omega' before you — rest, resurrection, feast — He is there. He brackets the whole quest.
